TAL_AXES_WORK_AXE_EYE.label: Work-Axe Eye
TAL_AXES_WORK_AXE_EYE.why: 'When you deal damage to an unattended wooden object with an axe, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage': the Attack an object action with an axe adds it (combat/ext/objects.py). The Advantage on checks to cut or break wooden objects and to read a structure's weak point are the GM's: no break check exists.

TAL_AXES_GATE_SPLITTING_BLOW.label: Gate-Splitting Blow
TAL_AXES_GATE_SPLITTING_BLOW.why: 'Against an unattended object, door, barricade, wagon ... spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus before the attack roll; on hit add 2d8 slashing or bludgeoning damage; reduce the target's Damage Threshold by your Proficiency Bonus for this attack only': one Attack an object variant per way to pay it (combat/ext/objects.py); the 2d8 takes the axe's own damage type and the threshold cut applies to that attack's damage instance. The exclusions (Domains; Formations and Barriers unless the GM names a vulnerable anchor or panel) stay the GM's: map objects are never those.

TAL_BERSERKER_GREAT_DESTROYER.label: Great Destroyer
covers: Great Destroyer: While holding Martial Focus
TAL_BERSERKER_GREAT_DESTROYER.why: 'While holding Martial Focus: deal double damage with melee weapon attacks against objects': Attack an object with a melee weapon deals double damage while Martial Focus is held, doubled once after the Damage Threshold, Immunity and Resistance (combat/ext/objects.py; Body Refining R8 order). The Advantage on checks made to break objects is the GM's: no break check exists.

tianxia.talent.berserker.the_blow_heaven.label: The Blow Heaven Refused to Receive
covers: If the attack strikes an object, structure, or temporary Barrier, deal double total damage.
The Blow Heaven Refused to Receive does not automatically destroy: artifacts;
tianxia.talent.berserker.the_blow_heaven.why: 'If the attack strikes an object, structure, or temporary Barrier, deal double total damage', with ordinary Damage Thresholds ignored: aimed at a map object or Barrier the attack resolves against its AC and deals double its own damage, ignoring the object's Damage Threshold (combat/ext/objects.py's direct row). The listed things it does not destroy are not map objects this table damages, so that line states the table's behaviour. The creature half of the ability (force damage, the Constitution save, its own Exertion talents, ignoring Resistance) is combat/ext/berserker.py.

TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_MERIDIAN_BODY.label: Iron Meridian Body
TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_MERIDIAN_BODY.why: 'When you use an Unarmed Strike to damage an unattended object, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage': Attack an object with an Unarmed Strike adds it (combat/ext/objects.py). The rest of the talent (magical Unarmed Strikes, Force damage, incorporeal creatures) is compiled elsewhere.

TAL_IRON_FIST_WORLD_TEMPERING_BODY.label: World-Tempering Body
TAL_IRON_FIST_WORLD_TEMPERING_BODY.why: 'While holding Martial Focus: your Unarmed Strikes can damage objects as though made with adamantine for the purpose of ignoring ordinary object Damage Thresholds': Attack an object with an Unarmed Strike ignores the object's Damage Threshold while Martial Focus is held (combat/ext/objects.py). The other benefits are compiled elsewhere.

TAL_VOID_UNMAKE_BARRIER.label: Unmake Barrier
TAL_VOID_UNMAKE_BARRIER.why: 'Against a wall, structure section, Force object or summoned object: ranged Cultivation Attack; this damage ignores ordinary object Damage Thresholds and deals double damage to temporary supernatural Barriers': aimed at a map object it rolls the attack against the object's AC and deals its damage, ignoring the Damage Threshold (combat/ext/objects.py). Barriers are not map objects, so the double stays the Barrier system's; it does not ignore AC, HP or Immunity.
